**Management Summary – Project LV 160,242 €**

The tender contains numerous medium‑severity specification gaps that collectively expose the client to cost overruns, schedule delays, and risk transfer to the contractor. Key issues include undefined site‑establishment scope (2,500 €), missing technical data for paving, asphalt layers, masonry, screed, plaster, insulation, frost protection, shaft construction, and PE‑HD pipe (total ≈ 9,500 €). Low‑risk items highlight potential risk shifting (1,250 €) and absent exposure classes (≈ 800 €). Immediate actions: (1) revise all work packages with explicit material types, dimensions, performance criteria, and reference standards (DIN, STLB‑Bau, GEG); (2) align pricing to detailed scopes to prevent bid‑price inflation; (3) update risk register to reflect clarified responsibilities. Prompt remediation will safeguard budget integrity and contractual clarity.
